08-24.text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.

08-25.text: Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this.

08-26.text: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

08-27.text: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”

08-28.text: Who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

08-29.text: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.

08-30.text: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

08-31.text: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

09-01.text: And that all this assembly may know that the LORD doesn’t save with sword and spear; for the battle is the LORD’s, and he will give you into our hand.

09-02.text: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.

09-03.text: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

09-04.text: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

09-05.text: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

09-06.text: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

09-07.text: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for the LORD your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.

09-08.text: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

09-09.text: The LORD himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.

09-10.text: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

09-11.text: Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.

09-12.text: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness. Break up your fallow ground, for it is time to seek the LORD, until he comes and rains righteousness on you.

09-13.text: The LORD will fight for you, and you shall be still.

09-14.text: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus.

09-15.text: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you.

09-16.text: The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.

09-17.text: Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

09-18.text: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.

09-19.text: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.

09-20.text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

09-21.text: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.

09-22.text: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.

09-23.text: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

09-24.text: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.

09-25.text: Blessed be the LORD, who has given rest to his people Israel, according to all that he promised. There has not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by Moses his servant.

09-26.text: For a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.

09-27.text: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.

09-28.text: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.

09-29.text: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.

09-30.text: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

10-01.text: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before the LORD, our Maker.

10-02.text: It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.

10-03.text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

10-04.text: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

10-05.text: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

10-06.text: The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.

10-07.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead.

10-08.text: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

10-09.text: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

10-10.text: A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way.

10-11.text: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

10-12.text: No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not fail you nor forsake you.

10-13.text: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, This is the LORD’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says the LORD of Armies.

10-14.text: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

10-15.text: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory.

10-16.text: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.

10-17.text: Pray like this: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.

10-18.text: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.

10-19.text: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.

10-20.text: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

10-21.text: Jesus said to them, I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

10-22.text: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men.

10-23.text: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

10-24.text: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.

10-25.text: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness.

10-26.text: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

10-27.text: The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.

10-28.text: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

10-29.text: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

10-30.text: You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.

10-31.text: For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God.

11-01.text: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.

11-02.text: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

11-03.text: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.

11-04.text: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us.

11-05.text: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God.

11-06.text: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

11-07.text: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to save many people alive, as is happening today.

11-08.text: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

11-09.text: It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.

11-10.text: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.

11-11.text: LORD, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

11-12.text: The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.

11-13.text: Honor the LORD with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase.

11-14.text: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.

11-15.text: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.

11-16.text: Peter said to them, Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

11-17.text: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers.

11-18.text: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’.

11-19.text: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

11-20.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

11-21.text: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

11-22.text: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.

11-23.text: I thank my God whenever I remember you.

11-24.text: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.

11-25.text: The LORD’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

11-26.text: Doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself.

11-27.text: But now the LORD who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.

11-28.text: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

11-29.text: But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.

11-30.text: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.

12-01.text: No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in judgment. This is the heritage of the LORD’s servants, and their righteousness is of me, says the LORD.

12-02.text: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

12-03.text: There is no one as holy as the LORD, for there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God.

12-04.text: Bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

12-05.text: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.

12-06.text: This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.

12-07.text: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger.

12-08.text: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.

12-09.text: Now, Israel, what does the LORD your God require of you, but to fear the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, and to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

12-10.text: And the LORD will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.

12-11.text: The LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD! The LORD, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

12-12.text: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

12-13.text: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

12-14.text: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”

12-15.text: Seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue.

12-16.text: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.

12-17.text: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

12-18.text: For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.

12-19.text: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

12-20.text: Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the stars forever and ever.

12-21.text: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

12-22.text: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

12-23.text: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own.

12-24.text: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.

12-25.text: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

12-26.text: And he said, LORD, the God of Israel, there is no God like you, in heaven above, or on earth beneath; who keeps covenant and loving kindness with your servants who walk before you with all their heart.

12-27.text: Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.

12-28.text: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.

12-29.text: The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

12-30.text: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.

12-31.text: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
